description: Stop: refuse to end the turn while a dispatched madbench:bench has not reported back. Every Agent call in this build is asynchronous, so the parent's reply closes the session and kills the operator mid-run. The command text says three times to block on TaskOutput; measured on MBN-1 with --repeat 5 twice, parents that actually waited were 3/5 then 2/5, so the wording is replaced by a mechanism. The hook is silent unless the transcript holds an operator dispatch with no terminal task-notification after it, and it gives up — allowing the turn to end — on an unreadable transcript, a dispatch older than 45 minutes, or after 6 consecutive blocks for the same task id. SessionStart with matcher startup runs magus-version-check, which reports a magus CLI that is behind npm's magus-cli latest and names the exact install command; it is carried by every hook-bearing plugin because magus 7.0.0 to 7.3.0 ask npm about the wrong package and can never discover or install their own fix, while the plugins update from the marketplace independently of the magus version. The copy here is byte-identical to the other five and gated by scripts/check-hook-copies.ts. All copies share one cache directory and claim one marker, so a session start costs one registry request and prints at most one notice however many of them are installed.
